subject: chemistry
content:
A compound AB has rock salt type structure. The formula weight of AB is 6.023 Y amu, and the closest A - B distance is Y1/3 nm, where Y is an arbitrary number
(a) Find the density of the lattice
(b) If the density of lattice is found to be 20 kg m-3, then predict the type of defect
